aarti.tek: Victory! I choose your refuge; salutations, salutations to you. Śrī Māteśvarī, victory to you, Tripureśvarī.
aarti.pad1: Śrī Māteśvarī, victory to you, Tripureśvarī, Rājeśvarī; victory, salutations, salutations.
Full of compassion, remover of every sin, who showers nectar: salutations, salutations.
aarti.pad2: Destroyer of the inauspicious, giver of all happiness, destroyer of the hosts of the wicked: salutations, salutations.
Slayer of Bhaṇḍāsura, victory to you, Mother; you who are full of compassion, salutations, salutations.
aarti.pad3: Remover of the fear of worldly existence, dispeller of suffering, give us refuge: salutations, salutations.
Consort of Śiva, who captivates the hearts of seekers, primal Power, victory to you: salutations, salutations.
aarti.pad4: Victory! I choose your refuge; salutations, salutations. Victory, Tripurasundarī, salutations, salutations.
Victory, Rājeśvarī, victory, salutations, salutations; victory, Mother Lalitā, salutations, salutations.
